record.summary: Moves the committed spec registry and codebase index from the legacy repository-root `.derived/` to `.statecraft/derived/`, the location the adopted Statecraft profile revision 14 and its managed instructions, ignores and AI review exclusion already name. Only the layout changes: the shard contents, the spec-spine pin, the CI profile and every managed file stay as they are.
